tools.name: contact_sales
tools.description: Submit a contact request to the Fingerprint sales team. Use this when the user wants to talk to sales, get a quote, request a demo, or discuss using Fingerprint device intelligence. Requires a business email address (personal/free email providers are rejected). The sales team replies by email.

email.description: Business email address of the person contacting sales. Free email providers are rejected.

fullName.description: Full name (first and last) of the person contacting sales.

jobTitle.description: Job title of the person contacting sales.

message.description: What the user wants to discuss with the sales team, including their use case.

monthlyApiCalls.description: Estimated monthly identification API call volume.
